topic: French (Quebec French) Google Ads keyword universe for MobilCube - mobile self-storage, Montreal area (fall/winter 2026-2027)
summary: This angle builds a 130+ keyword French universe across six clusters (mobile storage/container/cube; winter car storage; boats, powersports, RV and trailers; terrace furniture, commercial and seasonal storage; moving/renovation; geo modifiers) plus a 130-term French negative list. No public keyword tool exposed Quebec-level volumes during this session (Semrush/Ahrefs/Ubersuggest previews require login, the Parallel search tool hit its rate limit and the WebSearch budget was exhausted), so EVERY volume and CPC in the tables is an explicitly reasoned estimate flagged 'estimate', calibrated from (a) published US self-storage volumes ('storage units near me' 445k/mo, 'RV storage' 33k, 'boat storage' 30k - StoragePug, 2026-07-01), scaled to the Montreal CMA and its French-language share, (b) Canadian CPC benchmarks (home services CAD 6-25, Brand Butter 2026-04-15; US self-storage USD 4-15 in dense metros, StoragePug) and (c) the documented 20-40% French-vs-English CPC discount (ScaleMarketer, 2026-05-07). The client must validate volumes in Google Keyword Planner (Location = Montréal CMA + Laval + Longueuil + Laurentides/Lanaudière/Montérégie; Language = French AND All) before setting budgets. Key terminology finding: the category is called 'entreposage mobile' (GoCube, Cubeit, Location Conteneur Montréal), 'conteneur d'entreposage' (Cubeit, GoCube titles), 'cube d'entreposage' (GoCube, MobilCube) and 'entrepôt mobile' (Syldave); the dominant generic Quebec self-storage term is 'mini entrepôt', not 'garde-meuble' or 'box' (France). Winter vehicle terms are 'entreposage voiture/auto hiver', 'remisage' and, for boats, 'hivernage' (which also means winterization, so it needs mechanical negatives). Terrace-furniture storage ('entreposage mobilier de terrasse', 'entreposage terrasse restaurant') has almost no PPC competition - only 1215 Mini-Entrepôts (Rive-Sud) publishes a dedicated page - so MobilCube can own it cheaply. Google Ads treats accents (entrepôt/entrepot), singular/plural, stemming (hiver/hivernal), misspellings and function words (de, d', à) as close variants for exact and phrase match with no opt-out, and Keyword Planner reports one pooled volume for a keyword and its close variants; however, NEGATIVE keywords do not expand to plurals or synonyms (only casing and misspellings), so negatives must be entered in singular AND plural. Expected French CPCs: CAD 3.50-6.00 for generic 'entreposage montréal'/'près de moi' head terms, CAD 2.50-5.00 for mobile-container terms, CAD 1.50-3.50 for winter-vehicle and boat terms, CAD 1.50-3.00 for terrace/commercial long-tail.

findings.claim: Google Ads exact and phrase match automatically cover accents, plurals, stemming and misspellings; there is no opt-out.
findings.detail: Google's close-variant definition for exact and phrase match lists 'misspellings, singular or plural forms, stemmings, abbreviations, or accents', reordered words, added/removed function words, implied words, synonyms/paraphrases and same intent, and states 'By default, all keyword match types are eligible to match to close variants. There's no way to opt out.' Practical consequence: [entrepôt mobile] serves 'entrepot mobile', 'entrepots mobiles' and 'entrepôt-mobile'; [entreposage voiture hiver] can serve 'entreposage hivernal auto' via stemming + synonym.

findings.claim: Negative keywords do NOT expand to plurals or synonyms - only casing and misspellings - so French negatives must be entered in both singular and plural forms.
findings.detail: Google: 'Negative keywords automatically account for casing and misspellings, so you don't need to add those separately' and 'you'll need to add synonyms and singular or plural versions if you want to exclude them.' Allowed symbols in negatives are ampersand, accent marks and asterisk, so accented negatives (e.g. 'à vendre') are valid; because misspellings are covered, the unaccented 'a vendre' is also caught, but the negative table still lists both for safety.

findings.claim: Keyword Planner reports one pooled 'average monthly searches' figure for a keyword and its close variants, so accented/unaccented and singular/plural French spellings should be treated as one keyword for volume.
findings.detail: Keyword Planner defines average monthly searches as 'the average number of times people have searched for a keyword and its close variants', averaged over 12 months 'regardless of language', and warns that volumes are rounded so multi-location sums may not add up. Seasonal keywords (entreposage voiture hiver) therefore show a 12-month average that understates the October-November peak by roughly 3-5x; use the monthly breakdown.

findings.claim: Historically (2010) Google did treat 'credit' and 'crédit' as different keywords; that is no longer true for exact/phrase since close variants were expanded, but French practitioners still recommend adding both spellings for reporting clarity.
findings.detail: Oseox (2010-01-03) wrote that buying only 'credit' would not show on 'crédit' except in broad match, and that accent typos are 'légion'. Today's close-variant rules make duplicate accented keywords unnecessary; if both are added, Google serves the one with the identical spelling first, and the pair simply splits reporting. Recommendation: keep the accented form as the canonical keyword, add unaccented duplicates only where you want separate search-term reporting.

findings.claim: French-language auctions in Canada carry CPCs roughly 20-40% below English equivalents, and French campaigns show lower CAC.
findings.detail: ScaleMarketer (2026-05-07): 'CPCs in French are typically 20-40% lower than their English equivalents' and 'French campaigns deliver 20-35% lower CAC'; Brand Butter (2026-04-15): 'French campaigns often have lower CPCs and higher conversion rates in Quebec and bilingual markets.' This is the main reason the French keyword universe should carry the majority of MobilCube's budget.

findings.claim: Self-storage CPC benchmarks: USD 4-15 per click in dense US metros; Canadian home-services CPCs CAD 6-25; Canadian CPCs 'often run somewhat lower than US averages'.
findings.detail: StoragePug (2026-07-01) reports 'self storage near me' and 'storage units [city]' clear USD 4-15 where REITs bid; Brand Butter lists Home services CAD 6-25 and Real estate CAD 3-12; Little Dragon (2026-08-26) notes Canadian CPCs run somewhat below US and that secondary Canadian cities are 15-30% cheaper than Toronto. Applying the 20-40% French discount to a CAD 5-8 English Montreal storage CPC yields the CAD 3.50-6.00 head-term estimate used in the tables.

findings.claim: Published US volumes used as scaling anchors: 'storage units near me' 445k/mo, 'self storage near me' 82k, 'RV storage' 33k, 'boat storage' 30k.
findings.detail: StoragePug (2026-07-01). Scaling logic (estimate): Canada ~ 1/8.5 of US population; Quebec ~23% of Canada (ScaleMarketer); Montreal CMA ~ half of Quebec; ~65-75% of Montreal-area storage searches are in French. 445k -> ~52k Canada -> ~12k Quebec -> ~6k Montreal CMA -> ~4k French, spread across 'entreposage montréal', 'entreposage près de moi', 'mini entrepôt montréal', 'entreposage laval/longueuil' etc. This is how the 1,000-1,900 estimate for 'entreposage montréal' was derived.

findings.claim: Competitors name the category 'entreposage mobile', 'conteneur d'entreposage (mobile)', 'cube d'entreposage' and 'entrepôt mobile'; MobilCube's own French site uses 'Entreposage Mobile Premium', 'conteneur' and 'unité'.
findings.detail: GoCube: title 'Entreposage mobile - Location conteneur mobile', H1 'Service d'entreposage mobile simplifié', H2 'Vous avez besoin d'un cube d'entreposage si...'; Cubeit Montréal: title 'Louez des conteneurs d'entreposage mobile à Montréal', H1 'Entreposage mobile à Montreal'; Location Conteneur Montréal: H1 'Location de conteneur pour entreposage mobile', mentions 'cube d'entreposage'; Syldave: 'Entrepôt mobile Laval', 'Entrepôt mobile Montreal', 'Entreposage mobile Montréal'; MobilCube FR: title 'MobilCube | Entreposage Mobile Premium Rive-Sud & Montréal', H1 'Louez & Entreposez', plans 'Offre Avantage jusqu'à 180 $/mois' and 'Offre Liberté 350 $/mois'.

findings.claim: 'Mini entrepôt' (not 'garde-meuble' or 'box') is the dominant Quebec generic for self-storage and is heavily targeted organically.
findings.detail: Domains built on the term: minientrepotmontreal.ca, minientrepotjaune.ca, 1215mini-entrepots.com, montrealministorage.com. GoCube even positions the cube against 'mini-entrepôt'. Recommend a low-bid phrase-match test group so MobilCube captures 'mini entrepôt montréal/laval/longueuil' searchers with 'le mini-entrepôt livré chez vous' copy.

findings.claim: Winter car storage searches use 'entreposage voiture/auto hiver', 'remisage' and 'hivernage'; Montreal-area pricing anchors are CAD 225-720/winter and CAD 450-625/season for heated indoor.
findings.detail: Prix-Achat: prices 'pourraient débuter à 225$ (petit véhicule, pour l'hiver) et grimper aux alentours de 720$'; other listings 450-475 $/mois and a Nov 1-Apr 30 lease at 625 $ plus taxes; Joliette Récréatif from 199 $ moto, 299 $ Spyder/motoneige, 599 $ auto per season; Sport Collette (Varennes) 20 $/ft boats, 26 $/ft pontoons. MobilCube's 'Offre Avantage jusqu'à 180 $/mois' with a 5-month winter (~900 $) is above dealer seasonal pricing for motos/snowmobiles but competitive for heated car storage delivered to the driveway - ad copy should stress 'chargez dans votre entrée, on entrepose au chaud'.

findings.claim: 'Hivernage' is ambiguous (winterization service vs winter storage) and needs mechanical negatives.
findings.detail: soumissionsentreposage.ca uses 'hivernage/hivernation' for winterization and 'remisage' for seasonal storage. Run 'hivernage bateau' as phrase with negatives moteur, antigel, entoilage, changement d'huile, mécanique.

findings.claim: Terrace-furniture storage is an under-served keyword niche with a single organic competitor page on the South Shore.
findings.detail: 1215 Mini-Entrepôts page 'Entreposage de votre mobilier de terrasse - restauration' lists tables, chaises, luminaires, bars, jardinières, 25-200 sq ft units 'à partir de 60$ par mois'. No mobile-storage competitor (GoCube, Cubeit, Syldave) has a terrace/restaurant page. Volumes are tiny (10-50/mo per term, estimate) but B2B value per lead is high, so bid to top position and rely on phrase match plus DSA to harvest long-tail.

findings.claim: Mobile-storage rental price anchors in Quebec (for CPC/CPA math): GoCube 99-319 $/month (1 month) or 79-279 $/month (4 months), delivery 139-169 $ per trip; generic range 150-300 $/month.
findings.detail: soumissionsdemenageurs.ca 'Prix pour Entreposage Mobile, Cube & Conteneur d'Entreposage au Québec'. With a 5-month winter contract worth roughly 900-1,500 $, a CAD 3-5 CPC and a 5-8% landing conversion yields a CAD 40-100 cost per lead - viable.

findings.claim: Google is removing campaign-level language targeting for Search in September 2026; ads will match on the language of the ad itself, which makes separate FR and EN campaigns with fully French ad copy essential.
findings.detail: Language-targeting help page notes the upcoming change ('campaign-level language targeting will be removed... automatically match based on the language of your ads'). Brand Butter also reports that running un-translated English copy in Quebec raises CPC ~25% and halves conversion rate.

findings.claim: RVs, most travel trailers and 3-tube pontoons do not physically fit a ~160 sq ft cube; those clusters should be paused or re-angled toward contents/gear storage.
findings.detail: Cube is ~160 sq ft (MobilCube brief) vs. typical GoCube 5x8x7 ft and Cubeit/Syldave 16x8x8 ft containers. 'Entreposage VR' (400-800/mo est.) and 'entreposage roulotte' (300-600/mo est.) are high-volume but low-fit; keep only exact-match gear angles and make the size limit explicit in ad copy to avoid wasted clicks.

recommendations: Validate every volume in Google Keyword Planner before launch: Location = Montréal (CMA) + Laval + Longueuil + Terrebonne + Vaudreuil + Saint-Jérôme radius, Language = French, then re-run with Language = All to see the pooled figure; export the monthly breakdown for Oct-Nov peaks.

Campaign structure (French): (1) Entreposage mobile / conteneur / cube [exact+phrase, highest bids]; (2) Entreposage hiver véhicules (auto, moto, VTT, motoneige, bateau, remorque, motomarine) [phrase+exact, seasonal budget Sep 15-Nov 30]; (3) Terrasse / commercial / saisonnier [phrase, top-of-page bid, call-only ad variant]; (4) Déménagement / rénovation / temporaire [phrase]; (5) Géo long-tail (Laval, Longueuil, Brossard, Rive-Sud, Rive-Nord, Terrebonne, Repentigny, Boucherville, Vaudreuil, West Island, Laurentides, Saint-Jérôme) [exact]; (6) low-bid 'mini entrepôt' test group; (7) optional competitor conquest (GoCube, Cubeit, U-Box).
Keep the accented spelling as the canonical keyword (entrepôt, près, véhicule, motoneige, réno). Do not duplicate unaccented versions except for reporting; Google's close variants already cover them.

Enter negatives in both singular and plural and with accent (à vendre / a vendre, emploi / emplois); apply the shared negative list at account level, and add cluster-specific negatives (moteur/antigel for hivernage; logiciel/gestion for inventaire; industriel/palettes/logistique for commercial).
Never add the bare word 'québec' as a negative (it blocks 'entreposage mobile québec'); negate 'ville de québec', 'québec city', 'lévis' instead.

Bid ranges to start (CAD): head generic 3.50-6.00 (cap at 6), mobile-container 2.50-5.00, vehicle-winter 1.50-3.50, terrace/commercial 1.50-3.00 but target top-of-page impression share, geo long-tail 2.50-5.00. Move to Maximize Conversions with tCPA once 30+ calls/forms are recorded.

Write French RSAs that repeat the exact query terms: 'Conteneur d'entreposage livré chez vous', 'Cube d'entreposage - 160 pi2', 'Entreposage hiver auto - chargez dans votre entrée', 'Mobilier de terrasse entreposé au chaud jusqu'au printemps', 'Rive-Sud, Montréal, Laval - livraison 24-48h'. Add call extensions with 450-641-6498 and location extension for Boucherville.
Pause or restrict 'entreposage VR', 'entreposage roulotte' and 'entreposage ponton' to exact-match gear/contents angles; the cube cannot hold the vehicle itself.

Add a Dynamic Search Ads ad group over the French site's terrasse/commercial and véhicules pages to harvest ultra-long-tail (parasols, chauffe-terrasse, jardinières, équipement de paysagement) that Keyword Planner shows as <10/mo.
Use the search-terms report weekly in October-November to promote new French phrasings (e.g. 'entreposage char hiver', 'entreposage 4 roues', 'remisage side by side') into exact match.
